style: Possession-dominant positional play, high press, quick combinations and overloads through a technically elite midfield.
recent_form: Reigning European champions; arrived as one of the pre-tournament favourites despite a reportedly sluggish opening group draw.

key_players.name: Lamine Yamal
key_players.note: Generational dribbler and creator; eased in from injury but the team's main x-factor.

key_players.name: Rodri
key_players.note: 2024 Ballon d'Or winner back from a serious knee injury; controls tempo as well as anyone in the world.

key_players.name: Pedri
key_players.note: Press-resistant maestro who dictates rhythm and progresses the ball.

key_players.name: Nico Williams
key_players.note: Direct, explosive runner providing width and one-v-one threat.

key_players.name: Mikel Merino
key_players.note: Physical presence and aerial/goal threat from deep.

key_players.name: Mikel Oyarzabal
key_players.note: Reliable finisher and pressing leader through the middle.

historical_news: Reigning UEFA European champions arriving in form and confidence.
2010 World Cup winners, the peak of the tiki-taka golden generation.
Notable selection storyline: no Real Madrid players named in the 26-man squad.
Rodri's return from a major knee injury is a key narrative for the title bid.
Lamine Yamal's rise as the face of a new Spanish golden generation.

media_sentiment.label: positive
media_sentiment.summary: Strong favourites alongside France and Argentina, with some caution after a flat group-stage opener.
